contexts.text: Such is the whole arrangement of their fibres. AC 568:2.
According to the form, and the arrangement and determination of the parts...
The arrangement of all things into their order. Signified.
The scientifics acquired in childhood... are disposed by the Lord into order.
When the Celestial Spiritual... flows into the Natural... and disposes it as its own.
As these vessels (of the memory) are formed, and arranged in a series...
Each and all things with a man who is truly rational... are so arranged, that they mutually regard each other... All things are arranged in an order like that of Heaven; and this by influx...
With him, all things are disposed by the Lord according to the order which is from Him in the Heavens.
Each and all things (with man) are disposed by the Spirits and Angels with him.
(Abraham) set in order the woods () = the justice which was adjoined thereto... To set in order the woods upon the altar = to adjoin that to the Divine Human.
Unless man is in freedom... he can never be so disposed (by the Lord) that good and truth may take root.
The spiritual and celestial things in the Word follow in order most methodically.
The holy arrangement of general scientifics. Signified. AC 3057:2.
A species of light... whereby those things which are of thought are disposed into order.
That the Lord alone disposes their states. Signified.
This Divine arrangement is effected by the Lord, by means of Spirits and Angels.
The Lord acts through ends, and through them disposes the intermediates successively into order.
The Lord disposes the things (in the internal man), the man knowing nothing at all about it.
Through ends of good (in the Rational)... the Lord disposes all things which are in the Natural.

The Angels are arranged (in the form of Heaven) according to the consanguinities and affinities of good and truth... Thence truths and goods flow in with man, and are arranged with him into a like form, and this by the Lord alone.
(This) involuntary manifests itself in adult age... and meanwhile it has disposed and ruled all things of the thought and will...
Where the Divine is present within, all things are disposed into such an order, that they are able to be conjoined with genuine goods and truths which are in the Heavens. Explained.
The disposition of the power of interior truth. Signified.

The disposition of the power of interior truth, is the power of the interior man in the exterior... for all the disposition of good and truth in the natural man comes from the spiritual man, that is, through the spiritual man from the Lord, and in fact, through the truth there... wherefore all disposition in the natural man is effected by the interior. The natural man can never be disposed, that is, regenerated, otherwise.
As the disposition is effected by the interior through truth, power is predicated of truth.
It treats in what follows concerning the arrangement of the good and truth of the Natural to receive innocence.
Then all things are disposed and ordained in his Natural according to these things, so that they may be service and obedience.
The interior disposes the exterior.
The preparation and arrangement of the truths and goods in the Natural to receive the good represented by Esau. Signified. AC 4252 1.2.
To halve is to divide into two parts, and so dispose itself to receive.
(The eye perceives pleasure) according to the order or dispositions into series.
That truths were not as yet arranged into that order. Signified, Explained.
As the light of Heaven inflows into this light, and disposes it...

The very life (of the Grand Man) is from the Lord, who, from Himself, disposes each and all things into such an order... When, therefore, truths are disposed into such an order as Heaven is in, they are in heavenly order, and are able to enter good... The truths and goods with every man who is being regenerated, are disposed into such an order. In a word, the order of Heaven is the arrangement of the truths which are of faith in the goods which are of charity towards the neighbour, and the arrangement of these in the good which is of love to the Lord.
The arrangement of external truths under their own affection. Signified.
To divide upon to = arrangement.
Arrangement by natural good. Signified.
In what follows, it treats of the arrangement of truths by good; for when spiritual good... begins to act as principal in the natural mind, it arranges the truths which are there into order.
In this case, sensuous things are also arranged into order, so that they may receive light...
In the good of charity there is life from the Lord, when life arranges truths into order...
That which flows in immediately, disposes; and that which flows in mediately, is disposed...
Necessity and thence arrangement in the Natural. Signified.
Under the hand = for disposal in every necessity; for that which is in the power of anyone, is at his disposal.
Particulars are arranged under generals, and singulars under particulars... These arrangements or ordinations are signified in the Word by bundles...

All truths joined to good are arranged into series... The series themselves are also arranged in a similar way one among another. That there are such arrangements of truths joined to good, is wont to lie presented to the very sight in the other life... These arrangements derive their origin from the arrangements of the angelic Societies in Heaven; for as these are arranged, so also, with the regenerate, are arranged the series of truths joined to good.
It is necessary for a man to remove evils and falsities... and thereby dispose himself to receive the influx.
That the Celestial of the Spiritual arranged these (scientifics) in order in the Natural, has been treated of... Scientifics must be arranged into order there before the truths of the Church...
Under Ordain, see this reference.
That he so arranged. Signified.
To wash the faces, here, = to arrange so as not to appear...
Hence a disposing of the face contrary to their interiors... the face being so disposed that love towards him shines from it.
They sat before him = that they were arranged by his presence...
When the Lord is present, all things are arranged into order by His presence... The order itself consists in truths being rightly arranged under good.

He made them houses = that they were arranged into a heavenly form; (for this) = to arrange them into order; and they are arranged into order when into a heavenly form... The scientifics in the Natural are arranged into continual series. Explained.

But the arrangement of scientific truths in the Natural is varied with every man... If heavenly love dominates, all things are arranged by the Lord into a heavenly form... Into this form truths are arranged, and when they are so arranged, they act as one with good... Such is the arrangement which is signified by God's making houses for the midwives.
What is interior... thus disposed the External at its beck.
When a man is being regenerated... each and all things with him are disposed so as to receive heavenly loves.
Jehovah look upon you and judge = Divine disposal; (for) what Jehovah sees and judges, He disposes.

That these reasoning falsities were arranged fascicularly in the Natural. Signified. (For) all things which are in man's mind are arranged into series, and as it were into bundles; or into series within series, or into bundles within bundles. That there is such an arrangement, is evident from the arrangement of all things in the body. Explained.
The recipient forms or substances are arranged most fitly for the influx of life. Explained.
These (evils and falsities) are arranged in the order in which they favour. In the other life, these are unfolded according to the order in which they are arranged...
From the time when the Lord, from His Divine Human, began to dispose all things in Heaven and on earth... For previously the Lord disposed all things through Heaven.
When Spirits are to undergo temptations, the interiors, that is, the truths and goods, are disposed with them by the Lord into such a state...
The arrangement of the goods appropriated. Signified.
To prepare, when said of goods appropriated = arrangement... This arrangement is effected by the Lord at the end of each state.
The disposition (effected by) Divine truth with those of the Spiritual Church in the state before it is from good. Signified.
To judge = disposition thereby. (For) Divine truth does not judge anyone, but flows in and disposes that it may be received.
That they are then disposed by virtue of Divine truth. Signified.
To judge between a man and his companion = disposition among truths.
Disposition thus for ever. Signified.
To judge = the disposition (effected upon) truths.

The Lord's disposition is immediate through truth Divine from Himself, and is also mediate through Heaven; but the mediate disposition through Heaven, is also as it were immediate by Himself... The Divine disposition or providence of the Lord is in each and all things...
All good and truth... come from the Lord alone... in like manner all the disposition, which is continual, to that use.
Under Camp, see this reference, and at AC 8758.
Thus are arranged the Societies in Heaven, and so also are the truths and goods with the man who is being regenerated.
According to the quality of good, all truths are arranged with man, as a house by its lord.
Good is what arranges truths into series...
But it is to be understood, that the Lord arranges truths according to the man's good of life.
Thereby external things are arranged so as to agree with internal ones...
The Lord disposes all things in Heaven, in Hell, and in the world, by means of the truths which are from Him...
Because all things with the man who is being regenerated are arranged according to the order of Heaven...

For the Lord flows in with man through good, and thereby arranges truths into order; not the reverse; and in proportion as truths are arranged into order through good, evils and falsities are removed. AC 9846:2.
All scientifics are arranged into a heavenly form, when the man is in celestial love; and love arranges.
Ordination and disposal. Signified.

To number, when said of the things of the Church... = their ordination and disposal... The reason is, that to number involves a survey, and that which is surveyed by the Lord, is also ordained and disposed. The original term used here, means to... visit, command, and preside, thus to ordain and dispose.
The Lord does not number any army, nor the stars; but He ordains and disposes the things (signified thereby).

As it is of the Lord alone to ordain and dispose the truths and goods of faith and love with everyone in the Church and in Heaven, therefore, when this is done by man... it signifies the ordination and disposition of such things by man, and not by the Lord; which is not to ordain and dispose, but to destroy.
The arrangement of truths into their series. Signified.

To grind and to bruise = to dispose that they may be of use. When to grind is predicated of the goods which are signified by wheat or barley, it = the disposition and production of good into truths, and thus application to uses... Good is disposed into truths, and is thus qualified; for unless good has been disposed into truths, it has not any quality; and when it is disposed into truths, it is disposed into series adaptedly to things according to uses.

What disposition into series is, may be told in a few words. Truths are said to be disposed into series, when they are disposed according to the form of Heaven... In the members, viscera, and organs, each and all things are disposed into series, and series of series... Into like series are disposed the truths from good with man. (See Series.)
For all disposition into good, which is called Providence, is thence.
Truths, which he disposes analytically into orders...
Innocence... disposes and adapts to receive all the good of Heaven. (So the interiors of little children) are continually adapted and disposed to receive the good of celestial love.
As the interiors of the mind are disposed to the form of their own affections...
Natural heat... only disposes the seeds...
In this case the natural mind is disposed for submission...
Which operation is only a disposing that one thing may not destroy another...
If man were in the disposing of these things... As he is not able to dispose the external... what would he do if he were to dispose internal things?
So... if man were to dispose the interiors of the eye.
Is it not enough for him to know the externals, and to dispose them...

Therefore, as man disposes the externals, the Lord disposes the internals; thus in one way if man disposes the externals from himself, and in another if he disposes the externals from the Lord and at the same time as from himself.
Does not the soul, which disposes the interiors, also dispose the actions from them?... The quality is determined by the disposition in externals...
(The necessity that man should think and dispose from himself.) General article.
Unless man as from his own prudence disposes all things belonging to his function and life, he cannot be led and disposed from the Divine Providence.
The Lord, through His Divine Providence, continually looks out and disposes that...
Love... acts into the lower things (of the mind) according to their arrangement; wherefore... a chaste mind disposes the body; but a lascivious mind is disposed by the body.
Good cannot look out for nor dispose anything except through truth.
The whole Angelic Heaven is disposed into its form... from the Divine love through the Divine wisdom.
Under Order, see this reference.
Relatives belong to the disposition of many things into order...
As man disposes himself for the reception of God...
They who accommodate and dispose themselves for the reception of the Lord... TCR 143.
The active of accommodation and disposition is from the Lord.

There are four things which follow in order with the clergy: Enlightenment, Perception, Disposition, and Instruction... Disposition is from the affection of the love of the will; the delight of this love disposes...
The will disposes the understanding at its beck.
That the arrangement of the truths of faith is into series, thus as it were into bundles.
They look into the old will, and dispose all things there.
All from the same religion are arranged into Societies...
The proper management of possessions...
God... thus disposes human endeavours...
By the arrangement of Angels and Spirits into genera and species, or into classes...
That they may be disposed into... connections...
Through Spirits and Angels, God Messiah disposes human thoughts.
They are disposed by God Messiah.
The myriads of Spirits and Angels, all of whom God Messiah disposes and directs.
From the disposition and auspices... of God Messiah...
From such a disposition of the Angels around me...
So are disposed the things which are around...
Each and all things from the mercy and disposition of God Messiah. SE 337.
They are received... according to a hidden disposition, which is ordained by the Lord...
They disposed my face so as to be smiling and cheerful.
From his ends... man is disposed so as to be a member...
Providence is their disposition to good ends...
With all difference and variety according to their disposition and state.
Endeavours to put forth all his evil in various ways according to his disposition... The endeavours... are received according to his nature and disposition by the Lord, thus according to his state.
Spirits... do not know the disposition of the breathing.
It was only a representation of the disposition of the Lord through mediate Spirits...
According to the disposition of the Lord... SE 4037.
Openings having a different arrangement... Also openings having a like arrangement...
Hence it is evident, that there is a continual disposition of the vessels of man's corporeal memory; for as the vessels are disposed, so the Spirits speak.
I often observed, that only the organs of thought are disposed with me, and that Spirits spoke according to this disposition.
This was not visitation... but arrangement into order.
I will ordain a lamp for Mine Anointed ().
Ordain peace for us ().
Such is the coordinate and subordinate arrangement through the whole Spiritual World.
Thou disposest darkness, and it is night ().
I will arrange thy stones ().
To prepare a table () = to be spiritually nourished.
He hath set the world upon them ().
All these minds with little children are disposed by the Lord by means of an influx of innocence.
